get.description: Who can sign in to the demo, one per role.

delete.description: Undo a resolution; the documents' disagreement is back in front of the underwriter.

post.description: Pick one of the conflicting values, with a reason; resolution and rules run again.

get.description: Types a person can give a document (the email body is set by intake, never by hand).

post.description:
A person confirms what a document is. Lane learns its layout from it, with where it came
from, so the next document laid out the same way is typed with no model call. This is the
only way a known layout is made.

delete.description: Remove a person's label; the classifier's reading is back after reprocessing.

post.description:
Say what a document is, with a reason. The submission is processed again so the document
is read as that type; answers already in the cache cost nothing.

get.description: Each perturbed packet and the synthetic packet, with every expected effect checked.
Facts by id, for analyst footnotes and finding citations.

delete.description: Remove a correction; the documents' value is back.

post.description:
Correct a value with a reason; the correction stands until cleared, and the rules run
again.

200.description: Same email received before; existing submission returned

get.description:
Every learned layout, where it came from, how often it typed a page, and how the model
audit went. None ship with Lane: each was learned from a confirmed document.
Live work: services, workers by heartbeat, jobs and their leases, and today's spend.

A license card's photo is personal data: it is blurred unless an underwriter reveals it,
and each reveal is an audit event.

Word boxes for PDF pages, the cell grid for worksheets, the text for the email body.
Driver identifiers are masked in words, cells and text; worksheet dates read as dates.

post.description:
A senior underwriter accepts a rule outcome the agent's documents moved away from decline
(four-eyes on clearing a decline).

get.description: The guideline as rules: parameters, teams and every rule with the line it enforces.

One row per submission. A reply whose files were attached to a submission is part of
that submission's row, not a row of its own.

delete.description: Delete a submission and everything derived from it. The audit log keeps a record.

post.description:
A person says they sent the request (from their own mail). Lane records what was asked,
who and when, so the agent's reply is measured against it. Lane sends nothing.
An underwriter approves the analyst's estimated cost; it runs in the background.

A person confirms a suggested follow-up: its files join the earlier submission, which
runs again.
The underwriter decides. Lane's recommendation stays beside it, unchanged.

get.description: One email of the submission as it arrived, read from the stored message itself.

post.description: A person approves re-reading every pending document with the stronger model.

get.description: The analyst's findings alone (also part of GET /analysis).

post.description: A person says a suggested follow-up is a submission of its own: it is processed as one.

Run every step again from the stored files, with model answers only from the cache, and
compare everything produced with what is stored now. Nothing stored is changed; no model is
called.
Delete the submission, ingest its original email again with every file, and process it.
An underwriter without the authority asks a senior underwriter to decide.
